title: First captain gives economic destabilization as reason for secrecy

tellings.quote: why is this whole thing being kept secret and he talked about economic destabilization

plain: When Dan Sherman, a former Air Force sergeant who says the NSA hired him to communicate with aliens, asked why the whole thing was kept secret, the first captain over him in the early 1990s answered with economic destabilization. Michels recounts this to Sherman on the show, drawing on Sherman's account, and it would mean the secrecy was kept to protect the economy from shock.
